title: The Magic of Boundaries
coreMove: Boundaries set you free when repeated clear limits replace silence, resentment, and apology loops with cleaner terms, steady follow-through, and self-trust.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who spot resentment after the fact
exampleSpecs.stakes: The same conflict will keep replaying until the first quiet yes is named.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A record review reveals the silence, resentment, blowup, apology loop.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who measure worth by being available
exampleSpecs.stakes: One more small yes can quietly erase confidence in follow-through.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Interior thought tracks how follow-through becomes evidence.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who say yes before sorting the request
exampleSpecs.stakes: Attention is scarce, and unclear access can drain the next round of care.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The whole scene stays in pre-action allocation of time and attention.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A calm client today may cost the crew a louder fight later.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: One genuine two-bad-options moment tests whether peace means compliance.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who fear that exact terms sound cold
exampleSpecs.stakes: Hidden expectations create risk when access and timing are unclear.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two named people talk until the relationship terms become specific.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who expect limits to shrink connection
exampleSpecs.stakes: A posted rule may feel colder until follow-through shows what it protects.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Expectation of lost confidence gives way to a cleaner asking pattern.
